label: PCDD starts
description: Primary Care Dementia Data replaces the Recorded Dementia Diagnoses series. First published for October 2022, with figures back to April 2022. Figures before and after are not directly comparable.

label: Quarterly from Jun 2026
description: Publication moved from monthly to quarterly with a new 2026/27 specification. Missing practice data is no longer carried forward from earlier months. Monthly views stop at March 2026; use the Quarter view to see later data.

label: Incidence now quarterly
description: Incidence counts new diagnoses over a quarter instead of a month. NHS England says it is likely to be higher from June 2026 and is not comparable with earlier data.

label: New dementia type categories
description: Other specified and not recorded dementia type categories added.

label: Renamed young onset
description: Early onset dementia renamed young onset dementia (same measure).

label: London coverage increase
description: London's registered patients rise from 8.9m to 10.6m between March and April 2023 in the published data (and its dementia register by about 8,000).
